extDescription.message: A friendly mascot that spots scam messages in Gmail and WhatsApp Web.

badgeTitle.message: Purrtect checked this message. Click for details.

offlineNote.message: Quick check only — the Purrtect server could not be reached.

iClickedIt.message: I already clicked, paid or shared something

reason_keyword_credentials.message: Asks for codes, passwords or KYC

reason_keyword_money.message: Talks about prizes, refunds or payments

reason_keyword_threats.message: Threatens you with police or penalties

reason_keyword_secrecy.message: Asks you to keep it secret

reason_keyword_click_bait.message: Pushes you to click or install something

reason_keyword_job_scam.message: Promises easy money for simple online tasks

reason_keyword_impersonation.message: Pretends to be family or a friend on a new number

reason_brand_impersonation.message: Uses a company's name but links elsewhere

reason_risky_domain_ending.message: Link has an unusual web address ending

reason_ip_address_link.message: Link is just numbers, not a name

reason_url_shortener.message: Link is shortened, hiding where it goes

reason_lookalike_domain.message: Link pretends to be a well-known site

clickWarningBody.message: This message looks risky. The link goes to $1. Real banks and companies never ask for codes or passwords through links like this.

reassurance.message: Don't worry — this happens to many careful people. Acting quickly helps a lot.

happened_shared_id.message: I shared ID or card details

detailsPlaceholder.message: Tell us a little more (optional). Don't type passwords or card numbers.

static_step1_detail.message: Use the number on the back of your card. Ask them to block the card and stop any payments.

static_step2_detail.message: Start with email and banking. Use a new password you haven't used anywhere else.

static_step3_detail.message: Uninstall any app the message asked you to install, especially screen-sharing apps.

static_step4_detail.message: Report to the police or your national scam helpline. Nobody genuine will charge a fee to get your money back.
